format.storage: one canonical JSON line per event: {chain, event}; chain_n = sha256(chain_n-1 ‖ event_id_n) from GENESIS; UTF-8, LF

seq_layers.assignment: append takes no seq; _assign is its only source
seq_layers.seed_admission: line 5 holds seq 6: seq == index is broken (a gap, a duplicate or a reordering); the journal is refused, never partially read
seq_layers.append: run/end at seq 2, but the journal holds 1 events: seq == index
seq_layers.decode: line 6 holds seq 5: seq == index is broken (a gap, a duplicate or a reordering); the journal is refused, never partially read

JOURNAL_1_seq_gap.gap.jsonl: line 5 holds seq 6: seq == index is broken (a gap, a duplicate or a reordering); the journal is refused, never partially read
JOURNAL_1_seq_gap.reordered.jsonl: line 1 holds seq 2: seq == index is broken (a gap, a duplicate or a reordering); the journal is refused, never partially read

JOURNAL_2_duplicate_or_conflicting_ident.duplicated line: line 2 holds seq 1: seq == index is broken (a gap, a duplicate or a reordering); the journal is refused, never partially read
JOURNAL_2_duplicate_or_conflicting_ident.same seq, other content: line 1: the chain does not link — an earlier event was edited or removed, or this one was
JOURNAL_2_duplicate_or_conflicting_ident.same seq twice: line 2 holds seq 1: seq == index is broken (a gap, a duplicate or a reordering); the journal is refused, never partially read

append_site_refusals.non-lossless payload (NaN): story/begin: data is not JSON-lossless: non-finite numbers have no canonical form
append_site_refusals.unknown enum member: story/admitted: fields of the wrong kind or enum ['dispositions']
append_site_refusals.owner supplied by the call site: failure/observed: owner and retryable come from the taxonomy, never from the call site (§22)
append_site_refusals.a foreign error code: failure/observed: code 'OSError' is not a taxonomy code; a foreign error flattens to UNKNOWN (§22)
append_site_refusals.abbreviated parent SHA: story/begin: fields of the wrong kind or enum ['parent']
append_site_refusals.type outside the vocabulary: an event has a typed EventType
append_site_refusals.vocabulary type with no format-1 schema: tool/invoked has no payload schema in journal format 1; writing it is a format version bump (§35)
append_site_refusals.a seventh projection cited by a gate: gate/decision: fields of the wrong kind or enum ['projections']

f1_conformance.detail: Event fields, defaults ['ignorable', 'source_seqs'] and frozenness equal the RFC

residuals: a tail rewritten together with its chain links is detected only against an anchor held outside the journal (a cache row's head, an evidence record)
payload schemas exist for the 18 types P3's projections and P2's StoryAdmission write; the other vocabulary types are unwritable until a format bump gives them one
